summary: Sanders County, MT lookout site: cupola cabin, L-4 tower, then a 30-foot timber tower (1979); removed by 1990; concrete footings remain at the summit (2016).

facts.design: Cupola cabin (1928), then a 20-foot L-4 tower (1949) and a 30-foot treated timber tower (1979)
facts.status_note: Removed by 1990; concrete footings remain at the summit according to a July 2016 photo log

staffing.status: staffed in 1936 (newspaper item quoted on the Montana lookouts site)

20-foot L-4 tower (register, firelookout.com, peakbagging); the Montana site dates an L-4 house on a timber tower to 1957
Montana site: L-4 lookout house constructed atop a treated timber tower
Montana site: the older lookout structure was removed after sitting beside the tower for several years
30-foot treated timber tower replaced the 20-foot tower
Register: removed in 1990; firelookout.com: gone 1990; peakbagging: gone by 1990
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on August 30, 2015

corrections.why: The register says the 30-foot timber tower of 1979 replaced a 20-foot L-4 tower that dated from 1949; the 1979 structure was not the first on the site

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and firelookout.com give 1928; the Montana site gives 1927. The story reports both.

Register, firelookout.com and Peakbagging give 1949 for the L-4 tower and 1990 for removal; the Montana site gives 1957 for an L-4 house and 1961 for removal of an older structure. The story reports both.
Register gives 7,450 ft (2,271 m); firelookout.com gives 7464 ft. The record keeps the register figure of 2270.8 m.

notes_for_editor: The 1979 replacement and 1990 removal agree across the register, firelookout.com and Peakbagging. The Montana site's chronology (1927 cabin, 1957 L-4 house, 1961 removal) conflicts with those sources and cites a memo and newspapers that were not checked directly. The Forest Lookouts page gives no access rule, so no access level is set. A Forest Fire Lookout Association Facebook post mentions staffing, but its text was not readable from the cache, so it is not used.
